build_scope: Clean archived main plus language_source.hpp only; parallel PicoCalc and FLASH-language branch changes excluded.

implementation.source_window: Reuse the already-borrowed compiler suffix for oversized sources. Window starts stay on the old 256-byte grid, preventing repeated backwards parser probes from causing per-byte decodes.
implementation.small_sources: One verified full read per frontend invocation when the source fits; sizing and EMIT remain separate invocations.
implementation.fallback: Missing or too-small loan retains the 256-byte stack page. I/O, partial/late reads and failed verification are sticky failures, never a paging retry.
implementation.span_consumers: Byte access, CR/LF scan, NUL scan and source CRC consume bounded spans synchronously. This removes intermediate 64-byte copies without publishing or retaining a cache pointer.

measurement.method: Same resident, byte-identical merged Turochamp package, FOCAL, LANGVM, LANGIN and VMSTORE throughout A/B/A. Only BASIC varies. Original VMC snapshot restored, then reboot, before each stage; four searches per stage; complete USB eight-rank board wall clock.
measurement.cold_definition: First search with compilation and RAM fill; not reboot with an already-current chess file cache.
